top_findings: Missing /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt directory for AI search crawlers (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).
Opportunity to add HowTo & FAQPage Schema to beauty and fashion guides for step-by-step mobile rich snippets.
Speculation Rules not implemented (Preload Score: 75/100) — adding speculationrules can eliminate client navigation delay.
6 third-party script libraries (GSAP, Lenis, Lucide, etc.) served from external CDNs instead of self-hosted assets.
quick_wins: Deploy /llms.txt at the site root following the Lighthouse Agentic Browsing standard.
Add HowTo JSON-LD schema on the Korean Glass Skin routine guide.
Add Speculation Rules script tag targeting /edits and /wallpapers for instant page rendering.
Add explicit AI crawler policy headers/directives in robots.txt.

categories.name: Technical SEO & Infrastructure
what_works: Strict HTTPS with HSTS (max-age=63072000, includeSubDomains, preload).
A+ Security headers: nosniff, DENY frame options, mode=block XSS protection.
Edge routing correctly canonicalizes to https://www.teentimeglow.me/ without redirect hops.
Robots.txt correctly disallows private endpoints (/admin, /api/) and filtered queries.
Clean HTTP 404 responses on non-existent endpoints (no soft-404 catch-alls).
Sitemap.xml clean, indexed, and auto-discovered with correct priority weights.

findings.title: Declare explicit AI crawler directives in robots.txt
findings.description: Currently all crawlers except AhrefsBot fall through to the wildcard User-agent: * block. Explicit directives for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot clarify crawling vs training boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Add named User-agent blocks for GPTBot, Claude-SearchBot, and PerplexityBot with Content-Signal declarations.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Tested quality scores: Homepage (84/100), Glass Skin Routine (89/100), Capsule Wardrobe (89/100), About Page (91/100), Wallpapers (93/100).
Zero AI fluff patterns detected — authentic personal editorial voice by founder Rini.
Information density is very high (0.65 to 0.86 across content pages).
Explicit editorial disclaimer and non-medical advisory clearly stated.
Strong interactive content (Glow Quiz, Daily Quotes, Community Gallery) driving high engagement signals.

findings.title: Cite peer-reviewed scientific studies for skincare active ingredients
findings.description: Guides recommend active ingredients like Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid, and Centella Asiatica. Direct external links to scientific research (e.g. PubMed/dermatology journals) elevate E-E-A-T for health-adjacent beauty queries.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-3 links to PubMed clinical studies in skincare articles when discussing active barrier ingredients.

findings.title: Include 'Reviewed / Fact-Checked On' timestamps
findings.description: Currently articles show published/updated dates. Adding a visible 'Fact-checked on [Date]' reinforces ongoing freshness for Google quality raters.
findings.recommendation: Add a micro-byline with verification date near the author bio.

categories.name: Structured Data (Schema.org)
what_works: Extensive schema graphs: WebSite, Organization, Person (Rini), BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList, AboutPage, Quotation.
Proper entity linking via @id across publisher, founder, and articles.
Social sameAs links present for Pinterest and Instagram.

findings.title: Missing HowTo schema on step-by-step skincare & styling tutorials
findings.description: The Korean Glass Skin guide has defined numbered steps (Double Cleanse, Hydrating Toner, Barrier Serum, Glow Moisturizer, Daily SPF) which qualify for Google HowTo rich snippets.
findings.recommendation: Add HowTo JSON-LD schema with Step objects, supply requirements, and estimated completion times.

findings.title: Add FAQPage schema on articles with Q&A sections
findings.description: Articles answer common teen questions (e.g., routine for acne-prone skin, age suitability).
findings.recommendation: Markup question-and-answer pairs with FAQPage schema to capture accordion rich results.

findings.title: Enhance Wallpaper pages with CreativeWork/VisualArtwork schema
findings.description: Wallpaper pages use generic ImageObject. CreativeWork / VisualArtwork provides richer attributes (artMedium, creator, license).
findings.recommendation: Include CreativeWork schema with license and download links for Google Images authority.

categories.name: AI Search (GEO) & Agent Readiness
what_works: Full server-side rendering: 1,000+ words delivered directly in raw HTML without requiring JavaScript execution.
User-triggered AI agents (Claude-User, ChatGPT-User, Perplexity-User) are completely unobstructed.
Clean accessibility tree with valid headings, landmarks, and form inputs.

findings.title: Missing /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt
findings.description: AI models (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude) look for /llms.txt as an authoritative index of high-value resources and site structure.
findings.recommendation: Create /public/llms.txt with an H1, brief overview, and markdown links to core guides, quizzes, and wallpapers.

findings.title: Lack of Markdown content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown)
findings.description: Providing markdown alternatives allows AI retrieval tools to parse articles at fraction of the token cost without HTML clutter.
findings.recommendation: Serve markdown representations or link rel='alternate' type='text/markdown' versions of key edits.

categories.name: Performance & Resource Delivery
what_works: Preload score: 75/100. Hero LCP image properly prioritized with fetchpriority='high'.
BFCache optimization: Zero unload or beforeunload blockers, allowing instant back/forward navigation.
Zero console errors during Chromium headless rendering.

findings.title: Add Speculation Rules for instant intra-site navigations
findings.description: Users moving from Home to /edits or /wallpapers must wait for document fetch. Speculation Rules allow the browser to pre-render the target in idle time.
findings.recommendation: Inject <script type='speculationrules'> to prefetch /edits, /wallpapers, and /quiz on link hover.

findings.title: Consolidate or self-host external CDN libraries
findings.description: 6 external scripts from unpkg, cdnjs, and jsdelivr create separate connection overhead and DNS resolutions.
findings.recommendation: Bundle Lenis, GSAP, and Lucide through Vite into the client build.

phases.name: Phase 1: Quick Wins & AI Search Readiness
items: Deploy /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt at the public root.
Add Speculation Rules script tag in the base layout to boost navigation speed to near 0ms.
Add explicit AI crawler directives to robots.txt.

phases.name: Phase 2: Rich Snippet & Schema Expansion
items: Implement HowTo JSON-LD schema on step-by-step skincare and styling articles.
Implement FAQPage JSON-LD schema on articles featuring reader questions.
Add CreativeWork/VisualArtwork schema to the 4K wallpapers collection.

phases.name: Phase 3: E-E-A-T & Authority Reinforcement
items: Incorporate 2-3 scientific citations (PubMed/dermatological studies) into active ingredient guides.
Add 'Fact-checked on [Date]' verification tags to editorial bylines.
Promote guides on Pinterest and Instagram with deep links to build external domain citations.

phases.name: Phase 4: Asset Optimization & Monitoring
items: Bundle external CDN scripts (GSAP, Lenis, Lucide) directly through Vite.
Monitor weekly drift snapshots with claude-seo drift compare.
